pack_rectangles: pack a list of rectangle sizes into a single large rectangle with optional 90 degree rotation
pack_unique_rectangles: pack a list of Rectangle objects into a large rectangle deduplicating by identifier
create_Rectangle: create a Rectangle named tuple with xsize, ysize, and identifier for use with pack_unique_rectangles
create_PackedRectangle: create a PackedRectangle named tuple with x, y, flipped, and is_first fields
review_pack_rectangles: review the pack_rectangles function which performs naive rectangle packing with flipping support
